subject.title: feat(autoreview): opt-in private run telemetry and history reader

question: Should the shared autoreview skill own an opt-in persistent local telemetry/history feature, and should it land only after the auth/isolation foundation is separately accepted?
rationale: This introduces a new persisted operator-facing capability and configuration surface, while the submitted branch also carries an open companion feature; source review cannot determine the desired permanent scope or sequencing.

options.title: Sequence the foundation first
options.body: Merge or otherwise settle https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills/pull/157 first, then rebase this PR as telemetry-only with runtime proof.

options.title: Review the combined change
options.body: Accept the broader review scope and evaluate auth isolation plus telemetry as one coordinated operational feature.

options.title: Keep telemetry external
options.body: Decline persistent history in the shared skill and leave operators to collect run metrics through their own wrapper tooling.

recommendation.title: Sequence the foundation first
recommendation.body: Merge or otherwise settle https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills/pull/157 first, then rebase this PR as telemetry-only with runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The central autoreview skill history points to steipete as the strongest available owner for deciding shared-skill scope and sequencing.
